q1_issues.issue: The fused compound kind salt_bloom is used without its decomposition genus (Inheritance salt_bloom bloom), which the compound-kind rule requires (the head-noun genus is always emitted); the only Inheritance given to a genus position is the copular predicate 'crust'.

notes: Kind subject taking Inheritance and the split of the descriptive 'pale' / 'crystalline' from the head noun (no adjective-noun fusion) are correct. The definitional 0.99 confidence is defensible for a defining copular, though 'pale' would take the empirical 0.9 if read as contingent.
